tasks.prompt:
Your colleague received a delivery of office cabinets from you, but the screws were missing.
Write an email to your colleague. In your email, tell them:
-Why the screws are missing.
-How to resolve the issue.
-Apologize for the inconvenience.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
tasks.to: Robert Green, Office Supplies Subject: Apologizing for Missing Screws in Recent Delivery
tasks.subject: Apologizing for Missing Screws in Recent Delivery
tasks.sample:
Dear Robert,

I am very sorry for the problem with the recent delivery of the office cabinets. We understand that the screws were missing, and this must have caused you a lot of trouble.

There are two possible reasons for this mistake. First, it might have been a packaging error, and the screws were accidentally left out. Second, the screws may have been packed separately and sent to the wrong address by mistake.

To fix the problem, we will send the missing screws to you by express delivery today. You should receive them within two days.

Once again, I am truly sorry for this mistake. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Best regards,

Bruce Miller

Anzety Software
tasks.title: Write an Email
